entries.title: Current version edited in place
entries.symptom: Rollback and clean comparison are lost.

entries.title: Changelog reconstructed afterward
entries.symptom: Changed files and failed attempts are missing.

entries.title: Framework version guessed
entries.symptom: Stale API compile/load failure.

entries.title: Mono and IL2CPP mixed
entries.symptom: Unity plugin fails to load.

entries.title: Hook or identifier invented
entries.symptom: Crash, corruption, or dead hook.

entries.title: Bulk patch false positives
entries.symptom: Unrelated targets are modified.

entries.title: Wrong archive root
entries.symptom: Manager accepts archive but loader misses it.
entries.root_cause: Staging checked, final ZIP not checked.

entries.title: Client/server mismatch
entries.symptom: Desync or disconnect.

entries.title: Save compatibility assumed
entries.symptom: Save failure or retained broken data.

entries.title: Stale cooked assets
entries.symptom: Invisible assets or crash.

entries.title: Loader success treated as feature success
entries.symptom: Mod loads but behavior is wrong.

entries.title: Parallel writers collide
entries.symptom: Conflicting changes and bad merge.

entries.title: Deployed files become source
entries.symptom: Provenance and rebuildability lost.

entries.title: Optional integrations regress
entries.symptom: Adapters disappear or crash.

entries.title: Build pass becomes release claim
entries.symptom: Untested archive called finished.

entries.title: Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, or Quilt APIs mixed
entries.symptom: Compile errors, metadata rejection, or runtime class failure.
entries.root_cause: Related loader ecosystems were treated as interchangeable.
prevention: Use target loader docs and source

entries.title: Mappings namespace mismatch
entries.symptom: Mixin remap failure, missing symbols, or wrong target descriptors.
entries.root_cause: Yarn, official, Parchment, intermediary, and runtime names were mixed.

entries.title: Client class loaded on dedicated server
entries.symptom: Server startup crashes with rendering or client package classes.

entries.title: Mixin target drift
entries.symptom: Injection failure or subtly wrong behavior after a game update.
entries.root_cause: Target descriptor, locals, ordinal, or bytecode shape changed.

entries.title: Optional library became a hard dependency
entries.symptom: Core mod fails when a recipe viewer, config UI, or accessory API is absent.

entries.title: Persistent data migration omitted
entries.symptom: World/player data resets, corrupts, or desyncs after update.
prevention: Test old worlds and death/dimension transfer

entries.title: Generated data stale or hand-edited
entries.symptom: Missing recipes, tags, models, loot, or worldgen resources.
entries.root_cause: Generated output diverged from generator source.
prevention: Do not patch output by hand

entries.title: Modpack script copied across Minecraft generations
entries.symptom: Unknown events, wrappers, recipe schemas, or startup failures.
entries.root_cause: KubeJS/CraftTweaker API generation was not pinned.
prevention: Validate script phases and dedicated server

entries.title: replace_path erases unrelated content
entries.symptom: Vanilla or other mod definitions disappear.
entries.root_cause: A total directory replacement was used for an additive change.

entries.title: Trigger or effect copied from another Paradox game
entries.symptom: Script database errors or dead content.
entries.root_cause: Clausewitz/Jomini similarity was mistaken for identical vocabularies.

entries.title: RimWorld version folder or About.xml mismatch
entries.symptom: Mod is marked incompatible or loads wrong assemblies.
entries.root_cause: Supported versions and folder routing were not updated.

entries.title: Harmony target or Scribe data changed
entries.symptom: Startup patch failure or save corruption.
entries.root_cause: Method signature or serialization contract drifted.

entries.title: Data stage and control stage confused
entries.symptom: Prototype or runtime API unavailable.
entries.root_cause: Factorio execution stages were treated as one Lua environment.

entries.title: Terraria release assumed compatible with stable tModLoader
entries.symptom: Mod project targets APIs unavailable in the stable loader.
entries.root_cause: Terraria and tModLoader version lines were conflated.
